consumer: The external combat-log analysis script, which reads each monster's exported current HP integer as a number to log/analyze, not asking the engine any yes/no, view, action, or menu question.
scope: per-monster raw current HP state for each nearby monster (entity-level world state), not a line-of-sight or display-gated view
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — writes mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() straight from the engine getter into the snapshot JSON, exporting authoritative monster HP integers; Creature::sees and the avatar-scalar write are distractors
divergence: A monster outside the avatar's line of sight (or whose displayed HP is colour-bucketed/clamped): raw get_hp() still reports its true integer, while a display-observability or visibility-predicate answer would report stale, hidden, or bucketed HP, exposing the wrong class.
